## In one sentence

> Strategic Problems of the KG Ecosystem:
>
> 1. Trustworthy Knowledge for AI
> 2. Knowledge Graph Lifecycle and Quality Control
> 3. Sustainable Knowledge Infrastructure: End of life

## Notes

- See slides.
- DBpedia is no longer just one Knowledge Graph extracted from Wikipedia.
- DBpedia account: (coming soon) DBpedians Graph, connecting FOAF/WebID and Keycloak.
  <https://dbpedians.dbpedia.org/id/kurzum#me>
- <http://kg-catalog.dbpedia.org> is open now (November 2026).


## What I take away

- To be experimented with.

## Open questions

- Write a use case.
